flashcard_questions.q: A circuit in which all components are connected end-to-end in a single loop, so there is only one path for current to flow.
A circuit in which components are connected on separate branches, giving the current more than one path to follow.
The rate of flow of electrical charge, measured in amperes (A).

flashcard_questions.a: The potential difference across a component, measured in volts (V) — it represents the energy transferred per coulomb of charge.
A component that opposes the flow of current in a circuit. Its resistance is measured in ohms.
